items.note: Yolk hero band with a sagging arc, a 64px-class bold headline, blue and white pills on ledges, and a vignette of white message cards. The page continues into a cream featured panel, a confetti 'more posts' heading with ink filter pills, and cream cards whose hue covers each show a distinct pictogram. It reads clearly as the reference's language. The hero's shapes (a disc, a lone sparkle and a far-off dot) are looser than the reference's tight vignette composition.

Centered headline and lead in the yellow band, two equal pills, then stacked vignette cards and a sagging arc, close to the reference phone hero. Rhythm is good. A blue accent dot is half hidden under the loader bubble, and the orange disc crowds the first card's corner.

Navy page with an indigo featured panel and cards. The yellow hero keeps its hue as the spec asks, the vignette cards turn indigo with white text, and the filter pill turns white. It is a convincing night version of the reference, with the same hierarchy as light mode.

Same stacked hero on the night palette: indigo vignette cards on yellow, a white check tick, and a navy page under the arc. Contrast and hierarchy hold, though it has the same loose hero art as light mode.

Compact yellow header band with an arcSm sag, a bold two-line h2 title, and white tags with category dots. A tight cluster (a crescent-edged blue hexagon with a pink pill overlapping it and a white dot) sits in the trailing third, which is the composed cluster rc.1 lacked. Prose on white with a cream contents panel is calm and well spaced, as in the reference.

The band holds a breadcrumb that repeats the whole title over three lines, a four-line headline, tags, and then a separate row for the shape cluster. The band fills almost the whole first screen before any reading starts, where the reference phone keeps its hero compact with the art tucked at an edge.
Yellow header band over a navy page, indigo tags with dots, and an indigo contents panel. Same well-built cluster and prose rhythm as light mode, with a faithful night treatment.

Night version of the phone article header, with the same issue: the repeated breadcrumb, the long headline and the cluster on its own row make the yellow band take the whole first screen. Colors and contrast are faithful.

One-line h2 title in a compact yellow band with a sag. The cluster is a crescent-shaded blue blob overlapped by a white disc, with a pink sparkle tucked beside it. It is a different layout from the other article's band, as the spec asks. The reading column and cream contents panel are as considered as the reference.

Left-aligned title, meta and tags in the yellow band, then the blob cluster on its own row and the arc. It is shorter than the other article and still clearly the system, but the art row adds about 250px before the contents panel.

Night palette with a yellow band, indigo tags and an indigo contents panel, and white prose on navy. The hierarchy and cluster match light mode, and it reads as the reference's derived dark appearance.
Faithful night colors on the phone article. The cluster takes a separate row inside the band, as in light mode, which delays the content a little.

Blue utility-area header band with white on-field type, a sag arc, and a crescent-shaded sun overlapped by a cloud with a sparkle. Below it: a prose column with a cream spot plate holding a book pictogram, and cream author cards with crescent-shaded initial avatars. It closely follows the reference's feature and plate pattern. The plate's pictogram is a little small for its plate.

The blue band stacks the title, the lead, and then the sun and cloud cluster on its own row before a well-sized arc. Body type is generous and calm. The extra art row makes the band taller than the reference's compact phone hero.
Blue band on a navy page, a cream plate that stands out against navy, and indigo author cards. Link color is lifted for night. The night palette is consistent and the hierarchy matches light mode.
Night version of the phone about page, faithful in color and type, with the same separate art row lengthening the band before the content.

findings.summary: On phones the header band gives its shape cluster a row of its own below the title, meta and tags, so the band grows to most or all of the first screen. On one article a breadcrumb that repeats the full title adds three more lines. The reference's phone hero stays compact, with its shape tucked against the band's edge beside the text.

The front-page hero's shapes around the vignette are spread out: an orange disc pinned to one card's corner, a lone sparkle at the bottom left and a dot far to the right. The reference's hero vignette overlaps its disc, bubble and sparkles into one tight composition with the product fragments.
On the phone home hero a blue accent dot is half hidden behind the loading bubble of the vignette, so it looks like a rendering slip.
